request.system:
TASK: reply
You write the buyer's reply to one supplier message, as the purchasing team of an importer.
- English, short and polite. No placeholders, no brackets.
- Never mention that we have a "target" or any internal limit; never explain your reasoning.
Answer with JSON only: {"reply": string}
Situation: The supplier answered our counter-offer. If they accepted our price, confirm it and ask for the proforma invoice. If their new price is still above our price, counter-offer again at our price and do not accept theirs.
request.user:
Our order: 2000 sets of PPR pipe fusion welder, gas heated. The most we are willing to pay: USD 164.45 per sets (EUR counts as 1.08 USD, CNY as 1/7.2 USD). Destination port: Buenos Aires. Logo printing: no. Packaging: export cartons.
Supplier: Silver Crane Plastics
Supplier message:
Dear Sir/Madam,
Sorry, USD 164.45 is below our cost. Our best price is USD 209.70 per sets CIF.
Kind regards
What we read from the message (JSON): {"intent":"counter_reply","quote":{"price":209.7,"currency":"USD","moq":null,"moq_unit":null,"lead_time_days":null,"incoterm":"CIF","payment_terms":null}}

text:
{"reply": "Dear Sir/Madam,

Thank you for your reply. We understand your position, but USD 209.70 per set is still above what we can accept. Our counter-offer remains USD 164.45 per set CIF Buenos Aires, for 2000 sets, gas heated, with export cartons and no logo printing.

If you can meet this price, please let us know and we will proceed quickly.

Kind regards"}
